cases.case_label: Alu insertion-promoted 8.8-kb deletion removing NF1 exon 4
cases.mechanism_detail: An Alu insertion accompanied by an 8,758-bp deletion with breakpoints in introns 3 and 4 removes NF1 exon 4 in a proband with brain tumor; phasing and VAF suggest transmission from a mosaic father, though an early embryonic event in the child cannot be excluded.
cases.quote: One insertion promoted an 8,758 bp deletion (chr17:31159322–31168079 on hg38) spanning all of exon 4 (Fig. 2a).

cases.case_label: De novo Alu in NF1 exon 24
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo Alu insertion into exon 24 of NF1 (absent in both parents) in a proband with brain tumor, proposed as causal by disrupting NF1; no RNA analysis.
cases.quote: The other Alu insertion was mobilized to the 24th exon of NF1.

cases.case_label: De novo SVA in coding exon of TRRAP
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo SVA inserted into an exon of TRRAP (pLI 1.0) in a proband with ptosis from the SCD cohort; listed as potentially pathogenic but not functionally validated.
cases.quote: we also identified one SVA insertion mobilized into an exon of the TRRAP gene in one proband who was diagnosed with Ptosis (HP:0000508) within the Syndromic Cranial Dysinnervation (SCD) cohort

cases.case_label: De novo Alu in RREB1 3' UTR
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo Alu in the 3' UTR of RREB1 in a proband with Ewing sarcoma, highlighted because RREB1 is associated with Ewing sarcoma; no functional data.
cases.quote: In addition, we also identified one de novo Alu insertion in the 3’ UTR region of RREB1 in one proband with Ewing Sarcoma.

cases.case_label: De novo full-length sense L1 in LTBP1 intron
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo full-length L1 in sense orientation in an LTBP1 intron, with a rare exonic SNV on the other allele, is inferred to cause CDH through compound heterozygosity; functional validation is lacking.
cases.quote: One case is a full length de novo L1 insertion mobilized in the sense orientation to the intron of LTBP1.

cases.case_label: De novo Alu in intronic enhancer of NEK1
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo Alu inserted into a strong intronic enhancer of NEK1 in a patient with right aortic arch; proposed as likely explanatory but not functionally tested.
cases.quote: The insertion mobilized to a strong intronic enhancer of the gene NEK1.
